application_steps.value: Apply through a financing partner of your choice before starting the project; not directly with KfW.

funding.value: Loan up to EUR 200,000 per project, including up to EUR 80,000 working-capital financing. Not a grant.

geography.value: Both company location and investment location must be in Germany.

obligations.value: Interest is payable during repayment-free years, followed by monthly equal principal instalments; early repayments may incur compensation.

required_documents.value: Business plan for the financing-partner meeting; the page also links SME declarations, de-minimis declaration and credit-check consent. Listed planning templates are optional.

unincorporated.value: Natural persons planning an eligible establishment are listed; qualification, management, SME and bank credit requirements also apply.
